title: CO2 conversion to CO by reverse water gas shift and dry reforming using chemical looping
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00395K, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Keke Kang, Hiroshi Sampei, Yasushi Sekine
Chemical looping technology provides an efficient means of sustainable CO2 conversion to the important chemical intermediate of CO or syngas by changing conventional co-feeding of reactant into alternating feeding.
